name: Create a header plus full-width hero image starter pattern
query: Create a starter page pattern that opens with a clean header containing Site Logo, Site Title, and Navigation, followed by a full-width hero image cover.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Route to wp-patterns and identify whether the pattern is for page content or a template part
Step 2: Add Block Types metadata appropriate for a starter page or template-part pattern
Step 3: Use Site Logo, Site Title, and Navigation native blocks in a flex header
Step 4: Add a full-width Cover block below the header with no top margin gap
Step 5: Use a local or approved image asset with intentional focal point/crop behavior
Step 6: Escape and translate any custom visible text
Step 7: Verify header responsiveness, navigation behavior, and hero image rendering
success_criteria: Uses native Site Logo, Site Title, and Navigation blocks rather than static fake nav markup
Header and hero image form one page-opener composition
Includes correct pattern headers and appropriate Block Types metadata
Image source is local/approved and accessible handling is intentional
Avoids custom CSS classes, scripts, and inline style tags
Verification covers responsive header wrapping and hero rendering
